title: Devcontainer Backend Doctor
user: Mac-based teams changing between Docker Desktop, Podman, OrbStack, and Apple Container who need to know whether a devcontainer/Compose project will actually work before changing runtime.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that statically inspects devcontainer.json and Compose, probes a selected local backend, and reports incompatibilities for mounts, privileged mode, networking, architecture, GPU, and secrets.
constraints: No daemon mutation by default; never print secret values; backend probes must be opt-in and platform-version aware.
